mana_surge_ally_202609252208_01.en: Mana surge! Abundant power. Admirably little restraint.
mana_surge_ally_202609252208_01.zh: 法力涌动！力量充沛，克制却少得令人赞赏。

mana_surge_ally_202609252209_02.en: Mana surge! the invocation swells beyond its humble vessel
mana_surge_ally_202609252209_02.zh: 法力涌动！咒法膨胀，已超出这卑微容器所能承载。

mana_surge_ally_202609252210_03.en: Mana surge! Such potential. Let none of it be wasted on mercy.
mana_surge_ally_202609252210_03.zh: 法力涌动！如此潜能，别将分毫浪费在怜悯上。

mana_surge_enemy_202609252210_01.en: Mana surge! Their malice has acquired the means.
mana_surge_enemy_202609252210_01.zh: 法力涌动！他们的恶意，如今有了施展的手段。

mana_surge_enemy_202609252211_02.en: Mana surge! even a brute becomes formidable with sufficient power
mana_surge_enemy_202609252211_02.zh: 法力涌动！力量足够充沛，莽夫也能成为劲敌。

mana_surge_enemy_202609252213_03.en: Mana surge! an alarming abundance on the wrong side
mana_surge_enemy_202609252213_03.zh: 法力涌动！多得令人不安……却落在了敌人手中。

match4_ally_202609252214_01.en: Four matched. A calculated advantage. Exploit it.
match4_ally_202609252214_01.zh: 四连！精心谋得的优势。好好利用。

match4_ally_202609252214_02.en: Four matched! Let hesitation be their affliction, not yours.
match4_ally_202609252214_02.zh: 四连！让犹豫折磨他们，而不是你们。

match4_enemy_202609252215_01.en: Four matched an ugly display of competence
match4_enemy_202609252215_01.zh: 四连！这番能耐，实在令人厌恶。

match4_enemy_202609252215_02.en: Four matched. They dictate the pace. You endure the consequences.
match4_enemy_202609252215_02.zh: 四连！他们掌控节奏，你们承受后果。

match5_ally_202609252216_01.en: Five matched! A magnificent confluence. Put it to merciless use.
match5_ally_202609252216_01.zh: 五连！绝妙的汇聚。毫不留情地利用它。

match5_ally_202609252217_02.en: Five matched! An elegant arrangement, with decidedly inelegant consequences.
match5_ally_202609252217_02.zh: 五连！优雅的排列，带来的后果却绝不优雅。

match5_enemy_202609252217_01.en: Five matched. Fortune lavishes her gifts upon the undeserving.
match5_enemy_202609252217_01.zh: 五连！命运竟将厚礼，慷慨赐予不配之人。

match5_enemy_202609252218_02.en: Five matched what they lack in subtlety they now possess in force
match5_enemy_202609252218_02.zh: 五连！他们欠缺的精巧，如今由蛮力补足。

extra_turn_ally_202609252220_01.en: Extra turn. A brief monopoly on violence.
extra_turn_ally_202609252220_01.zh: 额外回合！暂且独享施暴的权利。

extra_turn_ally_202609252224_02.en: Extra turn. Make their reprieve a regrettably short one.
extra_turn_ally_202609252224_02.zh: 额外回合！让他们的喘息，短得令人遗憾。

extra_turn_enemy_202609252225_01.en: Extra turn. Their appetite exceeds their allotted time.
extra_turn_enemy_202609252225_01.zh: 额外回合！他们的贪欲，超出了分给他们的时间。

extra_turn_enemy_202609252227_02.en: Extra turn. No interval. No relief. Attend to your wounded.
extra_turn_enemy_202609252227_02.zh: 额外回合！没有间歇，没有缓解。照看你们的伤员。

cascade_ally_202609252232_01.en: Cascade. Each small success makes the next inevitable.
cascade_ally_202609252232_01.zh: 连锁！每一次小小的成功，都让下一次成为必然。

cascade_enemy_202609252233_01.en: Cascade. Observe how readily a disadvantage compounds.
cascade_enemy_202609252233_01.zh: 连锁！瞧，劣势是何等轻易地层层累积。

grand_cascade_ally_202609252233_01.en: Grand Cascade. The gratifying arithmetic of annihilation.
grand_cascade_ally_202609252233_01.zh: 大连锁！歼灭的算术，真令人满意。

grand_cascade_enemy_202609252234_01.en: Grand Cascade a succession of calamities yours to enumerate
grand_cascade_enemy_202609252234_01.zh: 大连锁！接踵而至的灾祸，留给你们逐一清点。

skull_ally_202609252234_01.en: Skull strike a blunt instrument an unequivocal result
skull_ally_202609252234_01.zh: 骷髅打击！粗陋的手段，确凿的结果。

skull_enemy_202609252235_01.en: Skull Strike. Your frailty. Brutally demonstrated.
skull_enemy_202609252235_01.zh: 骷髅打击！你们的脆弱，得到了残酷的证明。

armor_break_enemy_202609252238_01.en: Armor broken flesh must now answer for the failures of iron
armor_break_enemy_202609252238_01.zh: 护甲破碎！钢铁的失职，如今须由血肉偿还。

armor_break_ally_202609252238_01.en: Armor broken. Their confidence was regrettably thin.
armor_break_ally_202609252238_01.zh: 护甲破碎！他们的底气，薄得令人遗憾。

mana_drain_enemy_202609252239_01.en: Manadrain. An elaborate invocation. Nothing to sustain it.
mana_drain_enemy_202609252239_01.zh: 法力汲取！精妙的咒法，却再无力量维系。

mana_drain_ally_202609252239_01.en: Mana Drain. Grand Ambitions. Reduced to impotent muttering.
mana_drain_ally_202609252239_01.zh: 法力汲取！宏大的野心，沦为无力的呢喃。

barrier_ally_202609252240_01.en: Barrier. A prudent concession to your own fragility.
barrier_ally_202609252240_01.zh: 屏障！承认自身脆弱，也算明智。

healing_ally_202609252240_01.en: Healing. Enough to resume your duties.
healing_ally_202609252240_01.zh: 治疗！足够让你们继续履行职责了。

healing_enemy_202609252240_01.en: Healing. Our previous efforts require repeating. How tedious.
healing_enemy_202609252240_01.zh: 治疗！先前的功夫又得重来。何其乏味。

barrier_enemy_202609252241_01.en: Barrier. An obstruction. Not an absolution.
barrier_enemy_202609252241_01.zh: 屏障！不过是阻碍，而非赦免。

poison_ally_202609252242_01.en: Poisoned. A measured dose. A mounting debility.
poison_ally_202609252242_01.zh: 中毒！剂量精确，衰弱渐深。

poison_enemy_202609252242_01.en: Poisoned. The injury is small. Its ambitions are not.
poison_enemy_202609252242_01.zh: 中毒！伤害虽小，它的野心却不小。

summon_ally_202609252243_01.en: Summoning. Reinforcements of a questionable pedigree.
summon_ally_202609252243_01.zh: 召唤！援军来了，血统却颇为可疑。

devour_enemy_202609252244_01.en: Devoured. A lifetime of promise. Repurposed as sustenance.
devour_enemy_202609252244_01.zh: 吞噬！一生的前程，改作了腹中之食。

devour_ally_202609252244_01.en: Devoured. A practical solution to an anatomical inconvenience.
devour_ally_202609252244_01.zh: 吞噬！以务实的办法，解决肉身带来的麻烦。

summon_enemy_202609252244_01.en: Summoning their numbers improve their company does not
summon_enemy_202609252244_01.zh: 召唤！他们的数量增加了，货色却没见长进。

victory_normal_202609252255_01.en: A well-earned victory. Their resistance has been answered in full.
victory_normal_202609252255_01.zh: 应得的胜利！他们的抵抗，已得到充分回应。

victory_overwhelming_202609252257_01.en: An overwhelming victory. Their confidence outlasted their competence.
victory_overwhelming_202609252257_01.zh: 压倒性的胜利！他们的自信，比他们的本事撑得更久。

victory_costly_202609252258_01.en: A costly victory. Count the spoils, then count the missing.
victory_costly_202609252258_01.zh: 代价惨重的胜利。清点战利品，再清点未归之人。

victory_normal_202609252258_02.en: A satisfactory victory. Take what is useful. Leave the rest to decay.
victory_normal_202609252258_02.zh: 令人满意的胜利。取走有用之物，其余留待腐朽。

defeat_normal_202609252259_01.en: A bitter defeat. Your intentions were admirable. Your execution was not.
defeat_normal_202609252259_01.zh: 苦涩的失败。你们的志向值得赞赏，手段却并非如此。

defeat_crushing_202609252300_01.en: A crushing defeat. The enemy found your preparations altogether insufficient.
defeat_crushing_202609252300_01.zh: 惨重的失败。敌人已经证明，你们的准备远远不够。

retreat_normal_202609252301_01.en: A prudent retreat, better an abandoned ambition than another occupied grave.
retreat_normal_202609252301_01.zh: 明智的撤退。宁可放弃一桩野心，也好过再填一座坟墓。

defeat_total_202609252301_01.en: A total defeat. No witnesses remain to offer a kinder account.
defeat_total_202609252301_01.zh: 彻底的失败。已无见证者幸存，替你们留下稍体面的说辞。

defeat_normal_202609252301_02.en: An instructive defeat. The lesson was sound. The tuition ruinous.
defeat_normal_202609252301_02.zh: 颇有教益的失败。道理无可挑剔，学费却足以倾家荡产。

retreat_costly_202609252302_01.en: A costly retreat. You have saved what remains. Remember, what does not.
retreat_costly_202609252302_01.zh: 代价惨重的撤退。你们保住了剩下的。记住那些未能保住的。

retreat_normal_202609252302_02.en: An ignominious retreat. Pride proved heavier than you could carry.
retreat_normal_202609252302_02.zh: 耻辱的撤退。骄傲的分量，终究超出了你们所能承受。

heavy_enemy_202609252305_01.en: A grievous wound. Attend to it before it defines the battle.
heavy_enemy_202609252305_01.zh: 伤势沉重。在它决定战局之前，赶紧处理。

heavy_enemy_202609252306_02.en: A sobering impact. Revise your expectations.
heavy_enemy_202609252306_02.zh: 令人清醒的一击。重新估量你们的胜算。

heavy_enemy_202609252306_03.en: An ugly reminder, the enemy requires only one opening.
heavy_enemy_202609252306_03.zh: 丑陋的提醒。敌人只需要一次破绽。

spell_heavy_enemy_202609252307_01.en: Their sorcery deserves more respect than you have afforded it
spell_heavy_enemy_202609252307_01.zh: 他们的巫术，值得比你们先前更多的敬畏。

silence_ally_202609252308_01.en: Silenced. At last, a useful contribution to the conversation.
silence_ally_202609252308_01.zh: 沉默！这场交谈，总算有了点有用的贡献。

aoe_heavy_enemy_202609252308_01.en: Wounds throughout the ranks, triage becomes an exercise in sacrifice.
aoe_heavy_enemy_202609252308_01.zh: 全军皆伤。此刻的救治，不过是在选择牺牲谁。

frozen_enemy_202609252309_01.en: Frozen. Resolve proves a poor substitute for circulation.
frozen_enemy_202609252309_01.zh: 冰冻！意志再坚定，也替代不了流动的血液。

frozen_ally_202609252309_01.en: Frozen. Their intentions remain heated, the rest does not.
frozen_ally_202609252309_01.zh: 冰冻！他们的企图仍旧炽热，肉身却已冷透。

silence_enemy_202609252309_01.en: Silenced. All that learning, stranded behind the tongue.
silence_enemy_202609252309_01.zh: 沉默！满腹学识，尽数困于舌后。

transform_ally_202609252310_01.en: Transformed. A most thorough revision of their identity.
transform_ally_202609252310_01.zh: 变形！对他们身份的一次彻底修订。

transform_enemy_202609252311_01.en: Transformed, familiar flesh, subjected to unfamiliar terms.
transform_enemy_202609252311_01.zh: 变形！熟悉的血肉，被迫遵从陌生的规则。

transform_self_ally_202609252311_01.en: transformed. The former shape has outlived its usefulness.
transform_self_ally_202609252311_01.zh: 变形！旧日形体，已再无用处。

stun_enemy_202609252314_01.en: Stunned. An unfortunate time to lose one's faculties.
stun_enemy_202609252314_01.zh: 眩晕！偏偏在此刻丧失神志，何其不幸。

stun_ally_202609252314_02.en: stunned thought and action suffer a temporary estrangement
stun_ally_202609252314_02.zh: 眩晕！思想与行动，暂且分道扬镳。

entangle_ally_202609252315_01.zh: 缠绕！费尽力气，寸步难移。

entangle_enemy_202609252315_01.en: Entangled. Strength requires leverage. You appear to have neither.
entangle_enemy_202609252315_01.zh: 缠绕！施力须有支点。看来这两样你们都没有。

web_ally_202609252315_01.en: Webbed such elaborate talents undone by a little silk
web_ally_202609252315_01.zh: 蛛网！如此精湛的本领，竟毁于几缕细丝。

curse_ally_202609252318_01.en: Cursed. Their remaining comforts are subject to revision.
curse_ally_202609252318_01.zh: 诅咒！他们仅剩的安逸，也得重新估量了。

web_enemy_202609252318_01.en: webbed a humiliating predicament for so accomplished a practitioner
web_enemy_202609252318_01.zh: 蛛网！对如此老练的施术者而言，真是屈辱的困境。

burning_ally_202609252319_01.en: Burning. Their discomfort will require no further encouragement.
burning_ally_202609252319_01.zh: 燃烧！他们的痛苦，再不必额外催促。

curse_enemy_202609252319_01.en: Cursed an unwelcome amendment to your prospects
curse_enemy_202609252319_01.zh: 诅咒！你们的前景，添上了不受欢迎的一笔。

burning_enemy_202609252320_01.en: Burning. Composure is admirable. Extinguishment would be wiser.
burning_enemy_202609252320_01.zh: 燃烧！镇定值得赞赏，灭火却更为明智。

death_mark_ally_202609252320_01.en: Death mark! A prognosis of exceptional clarity. Will be wiser.
death_mark_ally_202609252320_01.zh: 死亡印记！诊断已再清楚不过。这样会更明智。
death_mark_ally_202609252320_01.reviewNote: Two local ASR passes detect an additional "Will be wiser" tail after clarity. Kept in subtitle; recording requires human listening review. Audio unchanged.

death_mark_enemy_202609252321_01.en: Death mark your continued existence has become a pending question
death_mark_enemy_202609252321_01.zh: 死亡印记！你们能否继续活着，已成悬而未决之事。

treasure_appear_202609252324_01.en: A treasure? Your next opportunity appears disinclined to wait.
treasure_appear_202609252324_01.zh: 财宝！你们的下一份机遇，看来不愿久候。

treasure_fled_202609252329_01.en: There goes your fortune. Remarkably fleet of foot.
treasure_fled_202609252329_01.zh: 你们的财运跑了。腿脚倒是出奇地利索。

treasure_defeated_202609252330_01.en: A profitable encounter for the surviving party, at least.
treasure_defeated_202609252330_01.zh: 一场有利可图的遭遇——至少对幸存的一方如此。

heavy_ally_202609260006_04.en: Excellent hit. Let them feel the full weight of your contempt.
heavy_ally_202609260006_04.zh: 漂亮的一击！让他们承受你们鄙夷的全部分量。

heavy_ally_202609260007_05.en: Splendid. Strike again, before they remember how to stand.
heavy_ally_202609260007_05.zh: 妙极！趁他们还没想起如何站稳，再来一击！

heavy_ally_202609260016_06.en: Tremendous blow, courage surges like a tide as the enemy crumbles.
heavy_ally_202609260016_06.zh: 强劲的一击！勇气在敌人溃散时，如潮水般涌出。

spell_heavy_ally_202609260018_02.en: Magnificent sorcery! Their suffering attests to your mastery.
spell_heavy_ally_202609260018_02.zh: 精妙的巫术！他们的痛苦，正是你们造诣的明证。

aoe_heavy_ally_202609260019_02.en: Glorious devastation not one among them left unimpressed
aoe_heavy_ally_202609260019_02.zh: 辉煌的毁灭！他们之中，无一不铭记于心。

encourage_ally_202609282004_01.en: Continue the onslaught! Destroy. Them. All.
encourage_ally_202609282004_01.zh: 继续猛攻！将他们，赶尽杀绝！

encourage_ally_202609282005_02.en: Press this advantage, give them no quarter!

encourage_ally_202609282006_03.en: Their formation is broken—maintain the offensive.
